newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares gain, ATX seen capped at 1,230 pts.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares gain, ATX seen capped at 1,230 pts.

text.p: 1410 GMT - Austrian shares end ahead on Wednesday after tentative start with index buoyed by across-the-board buying of blue-chips, notably VA Stahl and Flughafen.
Traders see ATX index hemmed into 1,210 to 1,230-point range.
* Top gainer microchip maker AMS, up 29 schillings at 1,100.
* Leading decliner beverage group BBAG, down 10 schillings at 755.

* Fireproof materials maker Radex-Heraklith up 8.9 schillings to 447.9 after reporting 1996 group net profit rose 24.6 percent to 582 million schillings and that it expected further earnings growth in 1997.
* April ATX future up 11 points at 1,228.5
